lineage.lycian: Adaptation of Melchert 2001b, itself largely based on Kalinka 1901, Friedrich 1932, Neumann 1979; later inscriptions and newer readings added by eDiAna.
lineage.carian: Digitalized/annotated by eDiAna; numbering and transliteration based on Adiego 2007, with later published inscriptions added.
lineage.milyan: Separate Lycian B partition; must not be merged into Lycian A statistics.

project_policy: eDiAna rows remain source-attributed digital edition evidence. Edition ancestry must be represented as dependence, not independent confirmation. New readings supplied by project scholars remain attributed readings until separately collated.
